Subject: Gaia Health trial success criteria and evaluation plan (post-call recap)

Hi Lena / Tom —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth for the trial plan and timing. Please confirm owners/timelines and flag anything missing.

Top-line goal
- Validate Redwood Inference as a low-latency, secure semantic assistant for clinician triage and intake workflows over a 2-week evaluation window. Key yes/no decision: proceed to a 6-month pilot or not.

Proposed success criteria (what Gaia needs to see):
- Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end < 250ms for 512-token requests (internal target: <200ms).
- Accuracy: intent/slot extraction F1 >= 0.88 on your annotated sample (we'll provide eval harness).
- PHI handling: successful redaction/obfuscation in 100% of redaction test cases and logged audit trail.
- Integration: secure SSO via SAML + API keys working in staging; no data persisted outside VPC.
- Ops: documented retries/backoff and observed throughput at peak simulated load (50 rps sustained).

Owners and immediate asks
- Integration & infra (Gaia): Lena Ortiz — provide staging access + data pattern sample by 2026-08-04.
- Technical lead (Redwood): Sean Gallagher — will own onboarding and load tests.
- Evaluation metrics & gating (Redwood): Karthik Iyer — will run the evaluation harness and produce the scorecard.

High-level timeline (proposal)
- Week 0 (Aug 3–7): staging access + config, SSO handoff, initial test dataset ingestion.
- Week 1 (Aug 10–14): integration verification, baseline performance runs, redaction smoke tests.
- Week 2 (Aug 17–21): evaluation runs, collect metric results, prepare scorecard.
- Exec readout (decision window): Aug 24–26 — request a 30-min slot for go/no-go.

Attachments: trial-success-matrix.xlsx (matrix of success criteria), MVP-eval-checklist.md (small checklist).

Next steps / asks from Gaia:
1) Confirm staging point-of-contact and whether procurement should be copied on technical setup emails.
2) Confirm availability for an exec readout Aug 24–26 (we can flex to Aug 27 if needed).
3) Share any additional security checklist items beyond SOC2 that we should validate.

I'll circulate a short mutual action plan once we agree on owners/dates. Thanks — trying to keep this lightweight so we can move quickly.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Mutual Action Plan (summary)
- Aug 3: Gaia provides staging access and SAML/OIDC metadata (Owner: Lena)
- Aug 5: Redwood completes SSO integration and confirms staging connectivity (Owner: Sean)
- Aug 10: Redwood delivers baseline performance report (95/99/avg) and preliminary redaction output (Owner: Karthik)

Contingencies and gating

- Procurement: if retention term negotiation extends beyond contract baseline, procurement will escalate to legal and likely push the SOW timeline.
